DEVOUT-BLOOD_OF_THE_GODS.description: At the start of combat, gain [green]{RegenPower}[/green] [gold]Regen[/gold], and gain [gold]Flagellant[/gold].
DEVOUT-BLOOD_OF_THE_GODS.flavor: The blood that oozed from the Devout's first wound. A reminder of her penance.
DEVOUT-BLOOD_OF_THE_GODS.title: Blood of the Gods
DEVOUT-MILK_OF_LIFE.description: At the start of combat, gain [green]{RegenPower}[/green] [gold]Regen[/gold], and gain [gold]Flagellant[/gold].
DEVOUT-MILK_OF_LIFE.flavor: The milk that the Devout will never again nurse. A reminder of her regrets.
DEVOUT-MILK_OF_LIFE.title: Milk of Life
DEVOUT-EYE_OF_FIRE.description: You can no longer [gold]Rest[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold]. You can now gain [gold]Strength[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
DEVOUT-EYE_OF_FIRE.flavor: As the Devout stares into the flames, she draws upon her wells of strength.
DEVOUT-EYE_OF_FIRE.title: Eye of Fire
DEVOUT-WISDOM_EYE.description: You can no longer [gold]Rest[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold]. When you [gold]Gaze[/gold], you now also gain [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
DEVOUT-WISDOM_EYE.flavor: As the Devout stares into the flames, she reflects upon her past.
DEVOUT-WISDOM_EYE.title: Wisdom Eye
DEVOUT-LOCK_OF_HAIR.description: When [gold]Braidbound[/gold] causes a [gold]Stun[/gold], heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] times.
DEVOUT-LOCK_OF_HAIR.flavor: A lock of the Devout's hair, sliced by the Architect in their primeval battle. Still glows with golden light, even eons later.
DEVOUT-LOCK_OF_HAIR.title: Lock of Hair
DEVOUT-SOUL_OF_LIGHT_AND_SHADOW.descript: Each time your [gold]Stance[/gold] [red]decays[/red], gain an equal amount of permanent [gold]Power[/gold].
DEVOUT-SOUL_OF_LIGHT_AND_SHADOW.flavor: The Devout's soul shines amidst the darkness, flowing and filling the flesh of her body.
DEVOUT-SOUL_OF_LIGHT_AND_SHADOW.title: Soul of Light and Shadow
DEVOUT-ARDENT_PSALMS.description: For every [blue]{Piety}[/blue]{singlePietyIcon} gained, heal again for the same amount.
DEVOUT-ARDENT_PSALMS.flavor: A stained-glass tablet unfurling many scenes from the parables and myths the Devout holds dear.
DEVOUT-ARDENT_PSALMS.title: Ardent Psalms
DEVOUT-SCYTHES_OF_PANDORA.description: When you gain {singlePenanceIcon}, apply [blue]{CharmedPower}[/blue] [gold]Charm[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DEVOUT-SCYTHES_OF_PANDORA.flavor: A silver rosary strung with sapphires and moonstones. The lower moon hangs in the air impossibly, as if suspended by invisible strings.
DEVOUT-SCYTHES_OF_PANDORA.title: Scythes of Pandora
DEVOUT-SWORD_OF_ELAIOS.description: Whenever you play [gold]Angur[/gold], gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
DEVOUT-SWORD_OF_ELAIOS.flavor: A golden rosary strung with rubies and sunstones. Grasping the amulet, the Devout finds strength in her faith.
DEVOUT-SWORD_OF_ELAIOS.title: Sword of Elaios
DEVOUT-MYRRH_FLOWER.flavor: A flowering bud preserved in myrrh. The sap whirls in spirals and vortices, coiling into helical patterns that seem intentionally designed.
DEVOUT-MYRRH_FLOWER.title: Myrrh Rose
DEVOUT-SOULBOUND_HEART.description: Apply [gold]Charmed[/gold] [blue]{CharmedPower:diff()}[/blue] to ALL enemies for each [purple]Soulflame[/purple] you let [gold]Exhaust[/gold] this turn.
DEVOUT-SOULBOUND_HEART.flavor: The Devout's soul touches those around her, lulling their rage and dulling their wits.
DEVOUT-SOULBOUND_HEART.title: Soulbound Heart
DEVOUT-ENDLESS_APPETITE.flavor: The Devout's hunger is voracious, despite her attempts to chain it.
DEVOUT-ENDLESS_APPETITE.title: Endless Appetite
DEVOUT-BRIGHTBURN_THURIBLE.description: At the start of each turn, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP, gain {singleEnergyIcon}, and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
DEVOUT-BRIGHTBURN_THURIBLE.flavor: The Devout's soul roils the sweet incense held within, boiling her fervent rage.
DEVOUT-BRIGHTBURN_THURIBLE.title: Brightburn Thurible
DEVOUT-MONOCHROME_RING.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Summon[/gold] a shade of the [gold]Beloved[/gold]. While this shade exists, gain {singleEnergyIcon} every turn.
DEVOUT-MONOCHROME_RING.flavor: A rose-crowned crystal ring, engraved with swirling runes of devotion between a couple due to be wed.
DEVOUT-MONOCHROME_RING.title: Monochrome Ring
DEVOUT-IRONCLAD_TRUTH.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Obliterate[/gold] to your Deck. Whenever you play this card, PERMANENTLY apply [blue]{HpLoss:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-IRONCLAD_TRUTH.flavor: "All things will die. But thou shalt not. Thou canst kill not that which lives not."
DEVOUT-IRONCLAD_TRUTH.title: [red]Unspeakable Truth[/red]
DEVOUT-SILENT_TRUTH.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Ouroboros[/gold] to your Deck. Whenever you play this card, PERMANENTLY apply [blue]{HpLoss:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-SILENT_TRUTH.flavor: "As it ends, so it shall begin. The hunter tears itself open searching for prey."
DEVOUT-SILENT_TRUTH.title: [green]Unspeakable Truth[/green]
DEVOUT-DEFECT_TRUTH.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Singularity[/gold] to your Deck. Whenever you play this card, PERMANENTLY apply [blue]{HpLoss:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-DEFECT_TRUTH.flavor: "Seeketh not perfection. Eventually, all things shall converge upon the absolute."
DEVOUT-DEFECT_TRUTH.title: [blue]Unspeakable Truth[/blue]
DEVOUT-REGENT_TRUTH.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Abyss[/gold] to your Deck. Whenever you play this card, PERMANENTLY apply [blue]{HpLoss:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-REGENT_TRUTH.flavor: "Thou proclaim thineself king? Thou canst hold not dominion over the soul."
DEVOUT-REGENT_TRUTH.title: [orange]Unspeakable Truth[/orange]
DEVOUT-NECROBINDER_TRUTH.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Gravemind[/gold] to your Deck. Whenever you play this card, PERMANENTLY apply [blue]{HpLoss:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-NECROBINDER_TRUTH.flavor: "Vengeance crushes thee. Carry their flames and be reduced to ash."
DEVOUT-NECROBINDER_TRUTH.title: [purple]Unspeakable Truth[/purple]
DEVOUT-DEVOUT_TRUTH.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Succubus Form[/gold] to your Deck. Whenever you play this card, PERMANENTLY apply [blue]{HpLoss:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-DEVOUT_TRUTH.flavor: "Your nature is intractable. Embrace your darkness and coax it to your will."
DEVOUT-DEVOUT_TRUTH.title: [yellow]Unspeakable Truth[/yellow]
DEVOUT-WEIGHTED_BELT.title: Weighted Belt
